[[File:Entrana icon detail.png|left|130px]]
'''Entrana''' is a large island south-west of [[Taverley]], occupied by [[Saradomin|Saradominist]] monks. When entering Entrana, adventurers are prohibited from bringing most [[weapons]] or [[armour]] with them.

==History==
Entrana is said to be where [[Saradomin]] first stepped foot on [[Gielinor]], and is therefore considered a holy site by his followers.{{Citation needed}} It seems that there was always some presence on the island since that time,{{CiteText|text=Display case (Varrock Museum, number 34)|quote=4th Age - yr 500-900 An early 4th Age map showing the human civilisations starting to settle into more permanent villages. After the God Wars, all the races began to rebuild their settlements.|note=Map shows Entrana on it.}} but there was no official organised township until the late [[Fourth Age]], when humans established towns on Entrana and [[Karamja]].{{CiteText|text=Display case (Varrock Museum, number 6)|quote=4th Age - yr 1937 Settlers established a town on the River Lum. Across the river they build a bridge and hence the town became called Lumbridge. This heralded more human settlements springing up early in the next age, where humans began to move into the desert, establishing Al Kharid, and towns on both Karamja and Entrana. }} When the art of [[Runecrafting]] was rediscovered by humans in the [[Fifth Age]], [[Runecrafting Crusades|barbarians invaded Entrana and destroyed the law altar]], believing the crafting of [[runes]] to be in defiance of the gods.

Many powerful artefacts have been on the island. Prior to the [[Betrayal of Zaros]], the [[staff of Armadyl]] was almost brought to Entrana, but was stolen en-route.{{CiteNPC|npc=Valdez|quote=The vile thief Rennard accosted me as I made my way to Entrana, and after defeating me with a sneak attack, plundered the staff from my person, and left me for dead...|loc=Curse of the Empty Lord|notes=|name=}} At one point in time, the [[Holy Grail]] passed through Entrana.{{CiteNPC|npc=High Priest (Entrana)|quote=The object of which you speak did once pass through holy Entrana. I know not where it is now however.|loc=Holy Grail|notes=|name=}} Later, during the year 169, an [[assassin]] stole an [[Relic (Devious Minds)|ancient relic]] from the monks which supposedly had the power to allow the [[mahjarrat]] [[Azzanadra]] to contact [[Zaros]].

==Accessing the island==
=== Transportation ===
* Via a ship in [[Port Sarim]] by talking to the [[Monk of Entrana|monks]] on the dock
* through the [[Law Altar]] via the [[Abyss]] in the [[Wilderness]]
* [[Balloon transport system]] 
* Docking there via the [[Sailing]] skill (requires 36 Sailing)
* [[Teleport to Boat]] — Entrana [[mooring point]] once a [[Boat|player-owned boat]] with a [[Greater teleport focus (facility)|greater teleport focus]] is docked there.

Before being able to sail or fly to Entrana, the [[Monk of Entrana|monk]] or a balloon transport assistant will search the player to make sure that there are no prohibited items being brought to the island. At the [[law rift]], the power of [[Saradomin]] is present and will prevent the player from bringing prohibited equipment.

If a player logs in on Entrana or exits the [[Law Altar]] with prohibited equipment, a [[Monk (Entrana)|monk]] will immediately appear next to the player on Entrana and knock them unconscious. The player will then reawaken in [[Port Sarim]] aboard the Entrana ferry, and exclaim {{overhead|Urrrrrgh!}}.

=== Rules ===
Generally, players cannot take any [[armour]] with attack or defence bonuses to the island. Most non-equipable items that deal damage (such as [[runes]] and [[poison dynamite]]) are allowed. Some items which violate these rules can still be brought to the island, listed below. 

Trying to [[Telekinetic Grab]] dropped items on the coast of [[Falador]] will result in a chat message saying {{mes|I can't reach that.}}. Additionally, players '''cannot''' smuggle weapons or armour to Entrana by opening [[Treasure Trails]] caskets there, as they cannot be received on the island; an alternate version of the drop table without prohibited items is rolled instead<ref>{{PlainCiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1276268920270393348|date=25 Jun 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/104301|archivedate=9 Dec 2020|quote=It rolls the table without such items being included, yeah. That also includes most equipable items, even items without stats such as Bob shirts. But it's a useful place to go if you want prayerbook pages.}}</ref>. This makes it useful for players seeking specific rewards such as god pages to open caskets on the island. However, [[Reward casket (beginner)|beginner]] and [[Reward casket (master)|master]] caskets may not be opened on the island; if attempted, a message displays saying {{mes|You cannot open this on Entrana, the monks are watching you too closely.}} Although monk's robes are allowed on the island, you are not able to receive the [[monk's robe top (g)]] or the [[monk's robe (g)]] from easy caskets here as they are considered a tier-specific clue unique on the easy clue loot table.

These casket restrictions do not apply in the [[Entrana Dungeon]], so opening them inside the dungeon will roll the regular drop tables. However, as you cannot return to Entrana from the dungeon, this cannot be used to smuggle items onto the island.

=== Skill training spots ===
There are four [[fishing spots]] on the docks, requiring either bait and a rod, or a [[small fishing net]]. There is also a fly-fishing location located on the river. A [[fishing rod]] spawns in the house right before the dock, and there is a [[chicken]] farm for [[feather]]s north of the dock. There is also a [[range]] nearby for [[Cooking]]. Players can bank their fish at the [[bank deposit box]] on the [[Port Sarim]] dock. Players can also find the following on the island:

* Willow, oak, and regular trees — choppable if players can obtain an axe.

* [[Hops patch]] — a patch for hops, which can be protected by [[Francis]].
* [[Law Altar|Law altar]] — an altar for crafting law runes, requiring a [[law talisman]] to enter.

=== Other ===
Entrana has a large set of docks with a port, allowing players to travel to [[Port Sarim]] and manage [[Sailing]] activites. There is also a sand pit for collecting [[buckets of sand]], and the fearsome [[Entrana Dungeon|Entrana dungeon]]. Finally, players can access the [[hot air balloon]], a unique but somewhat convoluted method of traveling.[[File:Law Altar outside.png|thumb|width=450x450|The law altar, viewed from the sea.]]

==Inhabitants==

=== Personalities ===

* {{Chatl|Auguste}}, a monk with his head in the sky, dreaming of something more.
* {{Chatl|Cave monk}}, a wary monk who warns players of the evil below the island.
* {{Chatl|Crone}}, an elderly lady who points players in the direction of the [[Fisher King]].
* {{Chatl|Francis}}, a monk farmer who protects [[Farming|crops]] for a fee.
* {{Chatl|Frincos}}, a monk who runs [[Frincos' Fabulous Herb Store]].
* {{Chatl|Fritz the Glassblower}}, a [[glassblowing]] enthusiast who'll pay for glass made by the player.
* {{Chatl|High Priest (Entrana)|txt=High Priest}}, the leader of the [[Saradomin brew|Saradomin]] church.
* {{Chatl|Mazion}}, a [[sand pit]] manager who [[The Hand in the Sand|finds something odd in his pit]].
* Several {{Chatl|Monk|txt=monks}}, holy men who will heal players if asked.
* {{Chatl|Monk (Entrana)|txt=Monk cleric}}, A man who kicks off players who violate the rules of Entrana.
* {{Chatl|Monk of Entrana|pic=Monk of Entrana (1) chathead|txt=Monk of Entrana}}, who enforces Entrana's "no weapons or armour" policy.
* {{Chatl|Port master|pic=Port master (Entrana) chathead}}, a port master who helps players with [[Sailing]] activities.
* {{Chatl|Tool Leprechaun|txt=Tool leprechaun}}, a green-clad fellow who can store gardening supplies and note produce.

==Trivia==
* Before the removal of the [[Axe head (random event)|axe head random event]], players commonly used it to smuggle axes onto Entrana by bringing their separate pieces.
* In the [[Trailblazer League (2020)|Trailblazer League]] game mode, players could smuggle [[black dragonhide armour|black]] and [[blessed dragonhide armour|blessed]] bracers, chaps, and body armour to Entrana without objection from a passing monk by exiting the [[Law Altar]] with the [[crystal of memories]]. It is unclear whether this works in [[Deadman Mode]] with [[sigil of last recall]]. Similarly, implings caught in jars could be smuggled via the Law Altar with a crystal of memories to Entrana, but jars with prohibited equipment still couldn't be opened on the main island. Attempting to do so yielded the message: ''You can't loot impling jars here.'' However, they could be looted inside the Law Altar itself. It is unkown whether impling jars could be smuggled with a sigil of last recall.
** In the [[Trailblazer Reloaded League]], players with the [[Banker's note (Trailblazer Reloaded, item)|banker's note]] could use it to un-note noted armour and weapons on the island. This was useful for completing clue steps that would otherwise have required players to craft the required items on Entrana.
